source.name: Z4nzu/hackingtool
source.attribution: HackingTool by Mr.Z4nzu; catalog metadata adapted for discovery. See upstream LICENSE.

notice: This is a curated OSINT-focused subset, not a bundled copy of HackingTool or its third-party tools. External tools are reference links only; ShadowTrace does not install or execute them.

tools.name: Domain Intelligence
tools.description: DNS A/AAAA/MX/NS/TXT/DMARC, certificate transparency and RDAP lookups.

tools.name: IP Intelligence
tools.description: Public GeoIP/network registration, reverse DNS and Shodan InternetDB indexed observations.

tools.name: Email Footprint
tools.description: MX infrastructure and exact-match public Gravatar, GitHub commit-author and OpenPGP signals where available.

tools.name: Username Footprint
tools.description: Provider-specific public profile checks with exact-match safeguards; results remain candidate leads.

tools.name: Phone Normalization
tools.description: Conservative phone normalization and country-code formatting; does not infer subscriber identity, carrier or private accounts.

tools.name: Crypto Address Signals
tools.description: Address-format recognition and supported public-ledger observations; no wallet-owner attribution.

tools.name: File Metadata Inspection
tools.description: Inspects supplied text/data-URL bytes and embedded text indicators; no fabricated EXIF or GPS values.

tools.name: theHarvester
tools.description: Collects publicly available names, emails, IPs, subdomains and URLs from supported public sources.

tools.name: Maigret
tools.description: Username search across public websites. Treat hits as candidate leads and manually validate them.

tools.name: SpiderFoot
tools.description: OSINT automation platform with a broad set of public-data modules.

tools.name: ReconSpider
tools.description: Open-source reconnaissance framework listed in the upstream HackingTool catalog.

tools.name: OWASP Amass
tools.description: Attack-surface mapping and subdomain discovery. Run only for domains you own or are authorized to assess.

tools.name: Subfinder
tools.description: Passive subdomain discovery from public sources; scope queries to authorized domains.

tools.name: Holehe
tools.description: Email-to-service presence checks. Not integrated; privacy-sensitive and may be rate-limited by providers.

tools.name: dnstwist
tools.description: Domain permutation and phishing-lookalike monitoring for defensive brand protection.

tools.name: ExifTool
tools.description: Reads metadata from local images, documents and media files. Not executed by the Cloudflare Worker.

tools.name: WiGLE
tools.description: Public wireless-network mapping service. Use only for legitimate research and privacy-respecting analysis.

tools.name: Gitleaks
tools.description: Scans repositories for accidentally committed secrets; scan only repositories you own or are authorized to review.

tools.name: TruffleHog
tools.description: Detects exposed credentials and secrets in source-control history and supported data sources.
